construction.map: delta_w = K * delta_m elementwise, K = -lr beta1 / (bc1 D), D = sqrt((beta2 v + (1 - beta2) c^2) / bc2) + 1e-8, c = clipped first-batch gradient; K independent of m and identical across arms
steps: draw g ~ N(0, I) float64 over the 18,911,616 flat coordinates from torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed)
LOCUS: rescale per group so the 9 group energy shares equal the locked FMEL2 e1e-1 h = 1 profile p_M
ORTHOGONALITY: remove the delta_w_M component within each group, re-apply the locus rescale
MAGNITUDE: scale to ||delta_w_M|| = 0.0124086 (locked FMEL2 e1e-1 abs(1))
INVERT: delta_m = delta_w / K (float64), added to exp_avg in float32; exp_avg_sq, step, weights, scheduler, stream untouched
